map.角焊缝有效截面积 A_e = 0.7 · h_f · L_eff，焊缝应力 τ: Effective throat area of a fillet weld A_e = 0.7 · h_f · L_eff; weld stress τ = F ÷ A_e; utilization = τ ÷ f_fw × 100%; F applied force, h_f leg size, l_w weld length. By default the arc start/stop defects at both ends are deducted: L_eff = l_w − 2h_f (this can be switched off); f_fw is the fillet weld design strength (commonly 160 MPa for Q235 + E43). Validation: F ≥0, h_f>0, L_eff>0, f_fw>0; τ ≤ f_fw is judged "pass".
map.A_e = 0.7·h_f·L_eff（角焊缝有效截面，L_eff 为扣除弧坑后: A_e = 0.7·h_f·L_eff (effective fillet weld section, L_eff is the effective length after deducting craters)
map.τ = F / A_e，应 ≤ 角焊缝强度设计值 f_fw: τ = F / A_e, which should be ≤ the fillet weld design strength f_fw
map.默认按「l_w − 2h_f」扣除起灭弧缺陷，可在输入区关闭: By default "l_w − 2h_f" deducts arc start/stop defects; this can be switched off in the input area
map.角焊缝承受 F=50 kN，焊脚 a=6 mm，两侧总长 L=200 mm。默认: A fillet weld carries F = 50 kN with leg a = 6 mm and total length on both sides L = 200 mm. With default crater deduction: L_eff = 200 − 2×6 = 188 mm, A_e = 0.7×6×188 = 789.6 mm², τ = 50000/789.6 = 63.3 MPa; with f_fw = 160 MPa for Q235 + E43, utilization is 39.6% and the weld passes.
